title: Eval-queue runner closes the radar -> served model -> measured evidence loop, with an attribution guard
summary: evalqueue.py reads the append-only eval queue (radar.py), collapses it to the latest state per (model_id, revision), and plans each queued or errored model: ready only when a registered provider serves exactly that model id, allows the analyst role (model-add --roles inline,analyst), and the model has suggested suites. The default incumbent is the cheapest usable provider for the class excluding the candidate and every provider serving a still-unproven queued model (so one experiment is never the baseline for another); --incumbent overrides. run() calls the protected harness (eval.run: incumbent vs candidate route, samples 1, max_calls per suite, EVR written, CAP observations recorded) and appends evaluated / invalid / error with EVR ids, accuracy and model_resolved. A run whose candidate row was answered by a different provider is invalid (FND-0014). `orchestrate eval-queue plan|run`. The catalog revision is recorded in the queue entry; the protected harness keys CAP evidence by model name, so revision-level CAP keys remain a follow-up.
